mechanical_rules.M-COMPOSED-NAME-FRAGMENT: string equal to a candidate stem minus 'foundry_' inside a file that composes 'foundry_{...}' -> SOURCE_INSPECTION_GUARD in tests
mechanical_rules.M-CURRENT-LAW-OR-CONTROL-ROUTE: canonical law / current router / control surface naming the candidate with a route verb -> CURRENT_OPERATOR_OR_LAW_ROUTE
mechanical_rules.M-EXECUTABLE-DIAGNOSTIC-ROUTE: diagnostic call (halt/raise X(/print/SystemExit/...) or emitted message constant with a route verb -> CURRENT_OPERATOR_OR_LAW_ROUTE
mechanical_rules.M-HISTORICAL-ZONE: HISTORICAL zone -> HISTORICAL_PROVENANCE, even when imperative (NC-R2-5)
mechanical_rules.M-IMPERATIVE-IN-UNMARKED-RECORD: imperative mention in an unmarked record -> no mechanical decision (manual adjudication or UNKNOWN_BLOCK)
mechanical_rules.M-IMPORT-OR-DYNAMIC-LOAD: python import or load shape -> BEHAVIORAL_CONSUMER
mechanical_rules.M-ORIGINAL-PATH-NAMES-LIVE-STUB-OR-TOMBS: archive/routing body mentioned without the archive/ prefix while the original path is still a tracked stub/tombstone -> FALSE_POSITIVE_OR_IRRELEVANT for the body
mechanical_rules.M-SIDECAR-JSON-PIN: JSON sidecar under tests/ naming the candidate -> POPULATION_PIN
mechanical_rules.M-TEST-READS-OR-ANALYZES-CANDIDATE: test statement or bound name reaching read_text/open/getsource/analyze_consumer/is_file/blob -> SOURCE_INSPECTION_GUARD
mechanical_rules.M-UNMARKED-RECORD-DESCRIPTIVE: descriptive mention in an unmarked record -> HISTORICAL_PROVENANCE
mechanical_rules.UNDECIDED: any other material-zone mention without an adjudication -> UNKNOWN_BLOCK
